items.text: Incorporated round 2 answered decisions into plan.md: (1) HTTP router settled as Go 1.22+ net/http ServeMux — moved from Pending to Settled decisions, updated Phase 3 routing code to use mux.HandleFunc with method patterns, added to Non-goals (no gorilla/mux or chi), added to Definition of Done. (2) CLI framework settled as cli-core ScenarioApp — updated Phase 4 with cli-core import details, added CLI Output section to Contract Decisions with default human-readable output per cli-steer guidance. All 11 decisions across rounds 1-2 are now settled and reflected in the plan.

All five readiness dimensions score 3/3. Problem clarity: the event bus gap is well-defined with completed research backing. Scope: in/out boundaries are crisp with explicit handoffs to sibling items. Approach: all 11 architectural decisions are settled (serialization, routing, CLI, shutdown, store types, pruning, glob matching, ingestion model, subscriber model, package structure, proto strategy). Testable: 9 test categories with concrete techniques (real SQLite, httptest, table-driven). Risk awareness: 5 risks identified with actionable mitigations including startup reconciliation for meta drift.

No remaining gaps. Both dependencies (research/vrooli-events-architecture, execute/vrooli-events-proto-schemas) are completed. The plan covers all 13 mandatory sections per the implementation-plan-authoring skill. The item is ready for execution.

plan_updates: Moved HTTP router (net/http ServeMux) and CLI framework (cli-core ScenarioApp) from Pending Decisions to Settled Decisions table. Removed the Pending Decisions subsection entirely — all decisions are now settled. Updated Phase 3 with explicit ServeMux HandleFunc patterns. Updated Phase 4 with cli-core import details. Added CLI Output subsection to Contract Decisions (default human-readable, --json flag). Added 'Do NOT use gorilla/mux or chi' to Non-goals. Added router and CLI lines to Definition of Done.
